title: Premiere reading of UNI’s sesquicentennial poem on Oct. 29
summary_en: Over 150 years, many voices have echoed through the campus of the University of Northern Iowa. Now, a series of representative experiences are celebrated in an official UNI sesquicentennial poem, “Voices & Echoes” by Vince Gotera.
